cases.display_title: AdamW or NadamW at a fixed budget?
cases.task_summary: Two freshly initialized GPT implementations train on the same GPT2-tokenized FineWeb stream for exactly 3,225 optimizer updates, then use the same 10,485,760-token validation slice.
cases.decision_rule: Compare final live-model per-token validation cross-entropy (lower is better) at the prescribed seed and horizon. Runtime and memory do not break a quality tie.

candidates.A: AdamW for the embedding, output projection and one-dimensional parameters; Muon for block matrices.
candidates.B: NadamW replaces AdamW for those parameter groups; block matrices still use Muon.

cases.insight: A fixed-update comparison asks about final model quality. It does not ask which recipe reaches a threshold fastest.
limitations: Editorial summaries are not a substitute for the six complete public files supplied in the Reasoning prompt.
